decisions.reason: Although its market evidence is weaker and it is farther from the core display business, the firm has some slack, is investing, and the portal supports one-stop customer coordination and stronger information security, so management would likely give it more time.
This product fits the established cardboard offer and its award-winning result is clearly above aspiration, making retention very likely.
As a close extension of the firm’s core display range with dedicated website presentation in a growing market, it likely meets enough aspiration to stay in the portfolio.

This small counter display is an adjacent, easy-to-sell format within the firm’s narrow specialist range, so boundedly rational management would normally keep it unless clear underperformance appears.
The large freestanding information display is close to the firm’s existing capabilities and customer base, and current organisational slack makes continued market testing more likely than withdrawal.
